source: Driver virtual body for the cockpit cameras (core/include/rg/camera_motion.h). The head is a damped spring-mass on the seat per car axis, driven by the chassis acceleration in the car frame (gravity not included, so a constant velocity or a slope gives no offset). Static eye deflection = deflection_m_per_mps2 x acceleration (braking at 1 g moves the eye ~6 cm toward the wheel), soft-limited to limit_m; pitch/roll follow the deflection. All numbers [AS] tuning values, the owner tunes them. The user setting camera.body_motion (0..1, default 1 = full) scales head translation and rotation. Per view gains: head motion only in the cockpit views (owner rule, PR #5); the VR cockpit never rotates the view, has no shake and no FOV change.
